tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung gi dkar chag/ 001 byang gter lcags sdong ma tshar lugs kyi dbang chog 'chi med grub pa'i sa bon/ 002 bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i zegs ma/ 003 gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi chog khrigs 'khrul med go sla'i ngag 'don bkod pa/ 004 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa'i 'od kyi cho ga'i las rim 'chi med 'byung ba'i nyin byed ltar bdud rtsi'i dpal ster/ 005 gzungs grwa lnga'i mngon dkyil nag 'gros ma yid ches khungs thub/ 006 gzungs grwa lnga rdo rje phreng ba lugs kyi bdag 'jug 007 thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i grwa lnga'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog la dogs gcod the tshom rnam sel/ 008 bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med mchog stsol/ 009 rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bstod pa/ 010 bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin po rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa/ 'gro kun thar par 'dren pa'i lcags kyu/ 011 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi sgrub dkyil lhan cig tu bsdebs pa lū hi dgongs rgyan/ 012 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs 'bring po nyams su len tshul bde chen snying po/ 013 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen dril bu lugs kyi phyi rdul tshon gyi cho ga'i mngon dkyil gnyis lhan cig tu bkod pa nges don gsal ba'i sgron me/ 014 shar mdo khams kyi paṇḍi ta kun mkhyen smra ba'i seng ge go ram chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gnyis lhan cig tu bkod pa nor bu'i phreng mdzes blo gsal mgul rgyan/ 015 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sam 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyor smin byed bdud rtsi'i nying khu/

016 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi sgrub dkyil dang po'i blo can rab gsal/ 017 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur tshul/ 018 dpal rwa tshar gnyis kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed pa rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum pa'i mngon dkyil lhan thabs cha lag bcas phyogs gcig tu bkod pa zab don rab gsal/ 019 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bshams dang thig rtsa/ 020 gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil bdag 'jug gi yi ge blo dman 'jug bde/ 021 ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis tshe dpag lha dgu'i sgrub mchod dkyil 'khor bdag 'jug gsal byed/ 022 dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa dge legs nor bu'i phreng ba gsang sngags mdzes rgyan/ 023 rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga dngos grub lhun grub/ 024 byad 'grol gser lde'i chog khrigs man ngag nying khu/ 025 sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tsha chog 'gro kun thar pa 'dren pa'i lcags kyu/ 026 ngan song sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i ro sreg sngon 'gro'i phung po chas 'jug gam rus chog zur bkol thar 'dren lcags kyu/ 027 rje btsun ri khrod ma'i cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa sdig sgrib nad gdon zhi ba'i byin rlabs chu rgyun/ 028 rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod/ 029 dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog pho brang chen mo'i mgon khang tshoms bar du rgyal zla'i tshes gcig la gtor 'dzugs 'don khrid snod bcud byin 'bebs/ 030 sha brgya zan brgya'i glud gzhung srid zhi sbyin mchod/ 031 gtsug gtor dri med kyi gzungs klog thabs/ 032 tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma/ 033 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje 'phags lugs la brten pa'i sgo nas bdag mdun bum gsum gyis rang gzhan la tshogs gnyis spel thabs mi bskyod klu dbang nor bu/

034 rdo rje gtum po'i las byang rgyun khyer mthong bas rnam grol/ 035 dpal rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i sgrub dkyil drug bcud snying po bdun pa/ 036 padma dbang chen rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ 037 padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing mchod pa'i rim pa/ 038 rta mgrin yang gsang brgyud 'debs zhal bskong / 039 gong chos ye shes rnam rgyal gyi ngor mdzad kyai rdor bdag bskyed dang kha rag ma'i gsol mchod/ 040 gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman 'jug bde/ 041 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman go bde/ 042 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ 043 mig 'byed kyi gdams pa ma rig ling thog sel ba'i gser thur/ 044 tshe dpag med lha dgu la brten nas 'chi bslu mthong ba don ldan/ 045 khro bo stobs po che'i bsgom bzlas phas rgol rnam gnon/ 046 rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le/ 047 rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang / 048 sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun nyams len gyi snying po bsdus pa/ 049 sgrol dkar tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa'i gsal byed dam zur 'debs/ 050 gu ru drag dmar gyi rjes gnang / 051 che mchog padma thod phreng gi sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam bzhag nyung ngu'i tshul du bkod pa blo dman rnams kyi rtogs pa/ 052 ri khrod ma'i cho ga'i zur 'debs byin rlabs chu rgyun spel pa'i gangs ri/ 053 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag gdams pa'i gnad kun gsal bar byed pa'i nyi 'od/

054 bla chen 'phags pa'i dngul gdung rin po che'i dkar chag dge legs bcud kyi nying khu myong grol chen mo/ 055 jo bo rin po che 'od zer 'gyed ma 'byon khungs/ 056 bzhi thog mgon khang chen mo gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bla ma'i lung bstan mngon du gyur pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 057 dpal ldan sa skya dang ngor e waṃ chos ldan gnyis kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis thog drangs sa lugs yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge chos rgyal rin chen gyi thugs dam dad rten thang sku che chung bcu bdun gyi dkar chag ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod/ 058 chos grwa chen po gsang sngags bde chen gling gi bca' yig lhag bsam nyi 'od gsal ba'i 'od snang / 059 chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i bca' yig ngo mtshar nying khu nyes sel legs spel gyi sman 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi/ 060 gdan sa chen po'i bya ba las kyi sne mor mngags pa rnams kyi bca' yig 061 rtse thab pa rnams nas bya dgos kyi rnam gzhag 062 lha khang chen mo'i dge 'dun g.yos khang gi las byed rnam gzhag gsal ston gyi yi ge las 'bras gsal ba'i me long / 063 chos grwa lho byang thun mong gi rung khang pa rnams nas bya dgos rnam gzhag 064 bar thab pa rnams nas bya dgos rnam gzhag 065 dmangs thab pa rnams kyis bya ba byed tshul gyi rnam gzhag 066 mgo zla'i bka' 'gyur bca' tsho/ 067 dpal rtse gdong chos sde gsang chen smra ba'i gling gi bca' yig bslab bya'i gnang bkag gsal bar ston pa sa steng padmo rgyas pa'i nyi 'od phrin las mkha' khyab/ 068 bsam yas lcog grwa'i bca' yig 069 chos grwa chen po chos 'khor lhun po'i bca' yig rin po che zung gi zhabs 'degs bslab bya'i gnang bkag gsal bar ston pa'i bca' yig rnam dag chos khrims gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 070 rgyun sgrog bzhi grwa'i bca' tshe/

071 hor rtsa bod rtsar song ba'i spyi 'gro/ 072 shrī sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yi ge/ 073 glang nag bkra shis chos sdings dge 'dun rnams la gnang ba'i spyi 'gro/ 074 dbu mdzad byams pa bstan 'dzin bar sdings rdzong chung la phebs skabs kyi spyi 'gro'i khra gzhi/ 075 shes dkar rdzong dpon dga' bo por gnang ba'i spring yig 076 bar sdings rdzong chung dpon slob byams par gnang ba'i spyi 'gro/ 077 chu yos zla ba 4tshes 10la gnang ba'i khra/ 078 sga 'dra'i gzhi bdag la spring yig dang / de'i ka la lho mar sbyar ba/ 079 hor khang gsar bar gnang ba'i spring yig 080 dpal sa skya'i gzhi bdag khyad par can klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen 'khor dang bcas pa la springs pa/ 081 sngags 'chang chen po nas bzung gdung brgyud rim can gyi ri rgya klung rgya la thugs gal shin tu che bar mdzad pa/ 082 rnam rab klong rtsa lho pas zhus pa'i spring yig 083 dpon tshe dbang rnam rgyal pa la gnang ba'i thang ka'i rgyab yig 084 kha'u sman chabs kyi gzhi bdag spyi la spring yig 085 rje btsun sa skya pa'i skyabs 'og rnams kyi gnod byed la springs pa/ 086 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs rin po che'i bris thang bzhengs tshul ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gter/ 087 ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi lam 'bras bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang 'bri tho/ 088 sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i zhal thang bris tho/ 089 yab rje bla mchod zhal thang 'bri tho/ 090 shing phag zla tshes la yab rje dam pa'i mchod thang rgyab gzungs 'bri tho/ 091 dpal sa skyar zhal gtor chen skabs zor las pa rim can nas sngon 'gro sgrub bsnyen gyi rten bla rdo bram gzugs kyi ri mo can gyi bzhugs khang zhing bkod tho/ 092 dngos grub gling du dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal gyi 'bur sku bzhengs pa'i byin rten gzungs bzhugs tho/

093 thar rtse rdo rje 'chang gi sku pur la snyan shal phul ba'i zhal dbyangs/ 094 mkha' spyod be'u bum bzhengs byang / 095 rnam sras sku bzhengs tshul/ 096 nang so pu trar rdor gong phul ba'i zhal yi ge/ 097 chu sprel zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bzhi la sgo rum nang so smug chung bcas su snyan shal phul ba'i zhal byang / 098 dbus su phebs skabs snyan shal so so'i zhal byang la dmigs te gsungs pa/ 099 gos sku zhal 'byed skabs kyi tho chung / 100 lha chen mkhan gsar skos skabs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tho/ 101 'jam 'don bya tshul ma rig mun sel/ 102 dus mdos skabs 'cham sku 'thon tshul/ 103 yang dus mdos gtong tshul ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i phyag deb lhan cig tu bsgrigs nas tshig tshogs phyung zhing gsal byed rim par bkod na/ de yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i chog bsgrigs phyag deb las/ 104 dus mdos zor las pa'i nyer mkho'i yi ge/ 105 g.ya' lung 'jag gshongs kyi 'khon sku 'bum byin can la nyams gso bgyis skabs gzungs 'phar song tho bkod pa/ 106 lcang can gung gi snyan shal zhal byang / 107 rnam 'phyang chu stod sa paṇa 'khrungs tshes thog gser khrir skyabs mgon gdung mchog nas rnam 'grel gzhung skyor mdzad skabs 'phan 'bul ba'i zhal byang / 108 phywa phrin nor bu'i chog rgyal sa lugs ltar gtong tshul 'dod dgu rab gsal/ 109 rje btsun sgrol ma la brten pa'i mdos kyi cho ga g.yul bzlog gi yi ge gong sa rdo rje 'chang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mthong ba don grub bka' gdams sa lugs rnying lugs sogs dang mthun par gtong tshul la phyag len gyi bab phal cher sa lo chen po yab sras kyi bzhed srol dang mthun pa/ 110 dpal sa skya'i phur sgrub chen mo'i 'chams la sogs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba phyag len mdzes rgyan/ 111 phur sgrub slob dpon gyi byed sgo zur 'debs/

112 rdo rje nag po chen po'i mdos zor gtso gyur gyi mdos kyi rnam gzhag gong ma rnams kyi yig cha bzhin nyams su len tshul sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs bla ma gong ma mang po'i phyag len la mdzad pa'i dbyangs rol 'chams sogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ji ltar 'jug tshul ma tshang ba med pa/ 113 rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi pa'i gtor skyong dam tshig bskang gsor nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris blo chung mig 'byed/ 114 mgon po'i mdos gtor 'phen rgyu/ 115 sa glang dmar chen gtor bzlog mdzad skabs kyi phyag len ji ltar bya tshul sngags 'chang mgul rgyan/ 116 dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin 'bebs kyi rol yig mthong ba rang grol gsal byed mdzes rgyan/ 117 bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang skabs kyi phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i deb yid 'phrog utpal gsar pa'i do shal/ 118 dpal 'byung po 'dul byed dang lha chen tshogs bdag sbags sgrub kyi mchod bskang gtor tho dbang chen dpal 'bar/ 119 'dod khams ma'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho dang rjes 'brel mdos gzhung / 120 dmag zor mdos/ 121 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma drug cu'i lag len la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'khrul med lam ston/ 122 'jigs byed drug cu pa ngor lugs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig 123 dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dang gur zhal sogs kyi gtor bzlog chig sgrub dang sgrub grogs nyung ngu'i byed tshul/ 124 dpal sa skyar bektse lcam dral gyi gtor bzlog la cho ga'i yan lag rnams ji ltar mdzad tshul rno myur 'phrin las sgo 'byed/ 125 rgyan mchog dus mchod dpyad khra mkhan rin po che'i dbus phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la zhu gsol/ 126 rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sgrogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la snyan du gsol ba/ 127 dge 'dun pa rnams la skyabs 'jug zhu yig

128 gdugs dkar la brten pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i lag len gyi cho ga 129 yos lo snron zla'i nyer gcig nas tshes mchod chen mo sogs/ de rnams kyi chos spyod gtong deb/ 130 drug cu sngags bon bca' yig drang thig dge legs kyi 'od snang / 131 phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bdag bskyed 'chi med snying po/ 132 mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs pa'i bum pa'i cho ga nyams grib mthar byed/ 133 dzaṃ dkar rjes gnang khams gsum dbang sdud/ 134 dbyangs can lha mo'i bsgom bzlas shes bya rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen/ 135 khyung nag gi rjes gnang / 136 mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba'i rjes gnang / 137 gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang / 138 me dbang 'byung 'dul rjes gnang / 139 rnam snang sgyu drwa nas gsung zhing / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i bsrung ba lnga gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang snying po gsal ba/ 140 rta mgrin shong lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ 141 rten bzhengs bzo bar nyer mkho bgegs mthar byed kyi bsgom bzlas 'gal rkyen rang grol/ 142 tshe dpag med dze tā ri'i lugs kyi bsgom bzlas tshe dpal ye shes kun 'grub/ 143 rig byed ma'i gnad yig gsal byed/ 144 rje btsun rig byed ma'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag tshar chen yab sras kyi phyag bzhes zab don 'khrul med/ 145 rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i chos skor dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi gsal byed dngos grub rab 'phel/ 146 ku ru kulle'i rjes gnang bya tshul rig byed lam bzang nyi 'od/ 147 rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed dang lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po mchod cing bskang ba'i cho ga brtan g.yo'i yid 'phrog dbang gi rgyal po/ 148 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon dkar po'i tshe sgrub 'khor 'das bcud len/ 149 zhal dkar po tshe 'phel gyi bdag mdun sgrub tshul tho/

150 dpal mgon zhal bram nag shan pa drug bskor gyi bdag mdun rnam gzhag nyung ngu shan pa rab dga'/ 151 grib ma khrus sel gyi nyams len/ 152 phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi nyams len/ 153 rgyal sras kun gyi 'jug ngogs theg chen spyi bye brag la 'jug tshul zab don sgron me/ 154 bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i rjes gnang go bde don tshang / 155 don zhags gzungs chog gi gsal byed sdug bsngal kun sel/ 156 grub brnyes sangs rgyas gsang ba yi/ /thugs dam lung lugs tshe sgrub kyi/ /nyams len snying gi thig le 'di'i/ /'gro kun 'jigs med tshe bcud bzhugs/ 157 dam tshig rdo rje'i sgrub thabs sdig sgrib kun 'joms/ 158 'dod rgyal rjes gnang / 159 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs sems dpa' bzhi brtsegs grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi ma ṇi bum sgrub byin rlabs kun 'byung / 160 kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ /phyag rdor rnam sras sbags sgrub la/ /khyer bde don tshang ngag 'don 'di/ /sa skya ngag dbang kun blos bris/ 161 lha mo shra wa ṇa'i sgo nas rmi brtag sgrub tshul dus gsum blang dor rab gsal/ 162 slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho/ 163 bla ma dam pa kun dga' blo gros dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sbags sgrub ku se dpon ngag dbang dge legs la chu yos zla 4 tshes 18 la/ 164 rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bla ma'i rnam 'byor nyams su len tshul 'dod dgu'i dpal ster/ 165 'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i char 'bebs/ 166 sa skya'i rje btsun yab chos mchog /rdo rje phur pa la brten pa'i/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len tshul/ /rgyud dang mi 'gal zab gnad bzhugs/ 167 zhwa lu lhun chos ngor mdzad dge/ 168

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ 169 rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'khrid 'chad tshul sa chen thugs thig 170 dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid 'chad thabs zab don gsal ba/ 171 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa 'chad tshul gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba nges don zab mo'i bcud thigs/ 172 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i khrus dang sbyin sreg yi ge sdig sbyong thugs rje'i snang gsal/ 173 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od zer mtha' yas/ 174 bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gzhi bsnyen byed tshul grub pa'i gsang gtam/ 175 rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg bcas pa/ 176 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje'i bsnyen yig mi bskyod dgongs rgyan/ 177 gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje klu sgrub lugs kyi bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gsang gsum ye shes me 'od/ 178 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa'i rnam bzhag bogs 'byin sbyin sreg bcas/ 179 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen yig nyung ngu sbyin sreg dang bcas pa khro rgyal dgongs rgyan/ 180 las gshin gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul/ 181 mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul log 'dren mthar byed/ 182 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ 183 thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gsal bar bshad pa rmongs pa mig 'byed lde mig

184 dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba yang dag zla gam gcig pa dang dgu pa'i bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i yi ge badzra he ru ka'i zhal lung / 185 dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin sreg dbus kyi nyi 'od/ 186 dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ye shes me chen/ 187 kun rig bsnyen pa'i sbyin sreg la cho ga dang bzlas grangs phral tshul/ 188 gu ru padma thod phreng gi sbyin sreg sgrib sel nyi 'od bzhugs pa'i dbu'o/ 189 chu yos zla 4tshes 18la glo bo pa zla ba bsam 'grub kyi ngor mdzad gur drag bsnyen yig dge/ 190 rdo rje khyung khra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus tshang 'jug bde/ 191 rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ba ri lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sdug bsngal rab 'joms/ 192 dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa birwa pa'i lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg las nyon sdig sgrib kun sel/ 193 rnam rgyal ma'i sbyin sreg 'chi med 'od 'bar/ 194 gur mgon lha brgyad kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i gtum drag me 'od/ 195 pho rkyang drag po'i sbyin sreg gdug can za ba'i 'jigs rung me 'od/ 196 tshe dpag med lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 197 rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu rnam par spel ba/ 198 dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i thab gter gyi man ngag ro bcud nus mthu'i snying po/ 199 sangs rgyas sman bla'i bsnyen yig nyung ngu don tshang / 200 slob dpon padma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di dang rjes 'brel tshe sgrub par yod na gong gi rim pa bskul lo zhes pa'i rjes su/ 201 gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 202 rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga 'khor lo bde mchog la sbyar ba byin rlabs rab 'byams/ 203 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rab gnas 'bring po'i ngag 'don bkra shis chu rgyun/

204 so 'brang 'khor lo bcu gsum ma'i rab gnas dang 'dogs tshul thun mong ma yin pa'i gsal byed 'dod dgu'i re skong / 205 dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yi/ /rab gnas byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i char/ /lnga bdo'i mi mthun rgud tshogs me/ /zhi byed thugs rje'i rgya mtsho/ 206 dpal kyai rdo rje sogs la sbyar ba'i rab gnas rgyas pa'i zin bris dang po'i las can 'jug bde/ 207 bkra shis chos sder mgon po'i rab gnas skabs kyi reg zig 208 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don dang phyag len gsal bar bkod pa las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba dngos grub myur stsol/ 209 dpal chen yang dag gi thig tshon byin rlabs sngags 'chang dgongs gsal/ 210 rdo rje nag po chen po tsa turmu kha'i dam tshig bskangs chog sngon 'gro bsham yig zur bskol/ 211 mgon po bcu bdun ma'i bskang ba dgra bgegs srog gcod/ 212 mgon po gyi ljang lugs bcu bdun ma'i gtor bsngo/ 213 stobs 'phrog dbang po la bskang bshags 'phrin bcol mdor bsdus srid zhi'i yon tan mthar phyin/ 214 bstan srung dbang po rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa nyung gsal go bde bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 215 gtor chog nyung 'dus/ 216 dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo/ 217 gur zhal rdo rje rab brtan ma tshe ring ma bcas kyi gtor bsngo/ 218 gtor bsngo don 'dus ma/ 219 rta mgrin yang gsang gi bdag bskyed phyag bzhi ma ning rnam sras rnams kyi gtor bsngo bskang ba phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sna tshogs gsal ba'i me long / 220 tse'u dmar po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ 221 bse khrab pa'i gtor bsngo/ 222 rnam sras gtor bsngo bsod nams g.yang 'phel/ 223 stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor bsngo bskang ba rab zab don tshang / 224 yi dam chos srung rnams kyi gtor bsngo bskang ba phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'phrin las dpal grub/

225 bstan srung thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral lha brgyad zhing skyong dbang po gtso 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa/ 226 dmar po skor gsum gyi gtor bsngo nyung ngu dngos grub myur 'gugs kyi pho nya/ 227 tshogs bdag gtor bsngo dgos 'dod bum bzang / 228 dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa khyer bde/ 229 tshangs pa zhi drag gi gsol mchod dge/ 230 dpal rta mgrin dang tse'u dmar po zung 'brel mchod phreng don 'dus dgos tshang / 231 btsan rgod tse'u dmar po'i gtor ma'i las mtha' nyung tshang rno myur/ 232 rdo rje legs ldan ma'i sku phebs skabs thod bcings/ 233 rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi bskang chog 234 legs ldan rgyal mo'i mchod phreng / 235 dkor bdag jo mo legs ldan ma'i 'phrin las/ 236 stobs 'phrog dbang po'i bskang bshags mdor bsdus/ 237 'on rgyal sras rin po che'i ngor mdzad dam tshig bskang gso'i reg zig 238 mgon chen gyi mdos nged rang nas gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i bsham yin/ 239 mdos thams cad kyi dkris byed tshul/ 240 tsa tur mu kha'i gtor mdos zung 'brel/ 241 dpal phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra ming sring gi drag po'i gtor chen gnam lcags zer phreng / 242 'di nang gtor bzlog dang mdos sogs kyi dmod bcol/ 243 chos rgyal sku lnga dang tse dmar ya ba skya bdun gyi rten mdos lag len gsal byed mkhas grub brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin/ 244 phur bzlog bshad pa'i mtshams sbyor/ 245 dpal rdo rje phur pa'i dmod bskul log 'dren tshar gcod dpa' bo'i nga ro/ 246 nag po chen po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i lhan thabs 'dod pa'i bdag po'i dpung gi srog gcod mtshon cha'i phreng ba/ 247 kha shog mi gsal kyang drug cu ma'i skor dogs dri zhig 'dra/ 248 zhal byang mi gsal yang / mgon po drug cu pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba/

249 mgon po drug cu pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i sngags rnams/ 250 lha brgyad zhal gtso 'khor lnga tse'u dmar mched bdun bcas la bstod bskul las bzhi'i dmigs pa mdor bsdus/ 251 gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar po la thugs dam gnad bskul gyi tshigs bcad btsan rgod rlung dmar gyi zhags pa dgra bgegs myur 'ching / 252 dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog 'bring po rdo rje'i me dbal gyi glog phreng bdud dpung zil gnon/ 253 ngor lugs 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i skabs su nyer mkho'i yi ge 254 stobs 'phrog zhing skyong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul drag po mtshon cha'i phreng ba/ 255 zhing skyong dbang po'i gtor chen la nye bar mkho ba'i dmigs rim gyi lhan thabs ma tshang ba med pa/ 256 rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus sku/ 257 thub pa'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya zhes yod pa'i phrin bcol/ 258 rdo rje rab brtan ma'i snyan shal phrin bcol/ 259 dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma la bstod cing phrin las bcol ba phrin las nyi 'od/ 260 zhing skyong tsa turmu kha la phrin bcol gyi tshig kā li mdzes pa'i phreng ba/ 261 dbon po lha rgyal nas bskul ngor sde dge'i gdung rabs myur 'byon phrin bcol/ 262 phrin bcol 'di ni chos skyong gtso bsdus yin pas 'di nas rang rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa rnams zur 'don gyi grangs gsog ma gtogs yongs rdzogs stabs gcig gtong mi dgos shing chos skyong rang rang gi bskang gzhung gi phrin bcol gyi thad sor 'di sbyar nas btang na khyer bde don tshang / 263 mahā kā la'i bstod pa bstan srung dgyes pa'i lha'i rol mo/ 264 skyes bu dbang gi mdog can la bstod pa 'jigs rung gshin rje'i gad rgyangs/ 265 rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung dang bcas pa la bstod pa dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra/

266 kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma la mchod gtor phrin bcol/ 267 'phrin las bskul tshig re smon lhun grub/ 268 dpal bsam yas kyi chos skyong tse'u dmar po'i sku rten pa khri smon sde par byung dus rten 'brel sku chas sogs phul ba'i phrin bskul/ 269 thod bcings bzhugs pa'i dbu'o/ 270 snang srid dregs pa'i ded dpon mthu bo che/ 271 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs mchu chen dbang gi rgyal po/ 272 lcam dral dang lha brgyad sogs kyi ru mtshon 'dzugs chog gi rnam bzhag dang dbyangs rol chog khrigs kyi tho/ 273 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog nag 'gros glegs grol/ 274 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog dbang po la ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i yi ge gtum drag gzi 'bum/ 275 stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas la gtang rag mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad dam can dgyes pa'i nga ro/ 276 dmag zor rgyal mo'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog dge legs nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od snang / 277 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gsang ba'i las mkhan lnga la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog srid zhi dbang rgyal/ 278 gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral gyi thug chog gtum drag 'od 'bar/ 279 dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar la bsten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog log 'dren g.yul rgyal/ 280 phrin las mgon po'i mnga' gsol bstan srung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ 281 bstan srung bse khrab can la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog khams gsum dpal 'bar/ 282 yam shud dmar po'i phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i cho ga gang bsam 'phrin las lhun grub/ 283 dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po dang dkar bdud phur srung bstan ma bcu gnyis bcas la mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad phrin las 'od 'bar bsam dgu lhun grub/

284 rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla ri dang bla mtsho bsam brling phu na bzhugs pa la gnas pa'i sman rgyal ma gnyis la gsol mchod bya tshul ci bsam lhun grub/ 285 dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi gling bzhi gling phran jo mo gling gsum sogs kyi gnas bsrung rnams la gser skyems 'bul tshul srung ma dges pa'i mchod sprin/ 286 dpal ldan khyung lung gnyan gyi re ma ti'i gsol kha mkha' 'gro'i 'dzum zhal rab gsal/ 287 srid zhi'i mgron la gtor ma gtong tshul shin tu bsdus pa/ 288 smyug la khu spe chos sde'i gzhi bdag thog rgod bkra shis kyis gsol kha thog rgod rab dga'/ 289 bse khrab can nam/ tshangs pa dung thod can nam/ rnam sras mdung dmar ram/ gnyan chen thang lha sogs rnam 'gyur dang mtshan tha dad kyi srung ma ngo bo gcig pa gsang phu ba'i gsol mchod rngog lo'i rjes 'dzin/ 290 dpal sa skya'i yab chos yang phur rnam gnyis kyi srung mar mchod gtor 'bul tshul ma mo rab dga'/ 291 bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod tshul gangs ljongs rjes brtse rab bskul/ 292 'go ba'i lha lnga gsol mchod 'jig rten bde 'byung / 293 bsam yas pho lha skya ser gsol mchod/ 294 rme brtsegs ljang dud la bsten pa'i grib glud rdzong chog 'gal rkyen mun sel khro bo'i gzi 'od/ 295 gter ston rdo rje gling pas gter ma lha mo bu rdzi mas mdos gzhung ngag 'don/ 296 ku ru kulle sngon mo'i char 'bebs dang sad bsrung gi yi ge bklag chog ma 'gro la dge ba'i lhag bsam bsil zer/ 297 gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang la 'jigs byed skor gyi bka' 'dri zhus tho dang dris lan/ 298 chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal dpal mgon zhal la bcol gdams gnyer gtad kyi yi ge dam tshig rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ 299 chos srung la gnyer gtad bka' bsgo/ 300 rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs la brten pa'i bka' bsgo/

301 dpal sa skya'i mnga' 'bangs cha zhabs bcu dpon shing byi lo pa'i bcu phreng mi pho mo kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams lus stobs lang tsho rigs brgyud dpal 'byor srog dbang klung rta sogs legs tshogs thams cad dar la shin tu drag par bskyed cig sogs/ 302 'brul gtor dbu'o/ 303 chu gtor grangs gsog byed tshul khyer bde don tshang / 304 lan gtor gtong tshul dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos brtsams pa/ 305 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod zab don snying khu/ 306 bar do ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag thar lam gsal byed/ 307 lo glud cha tshang / 308 rnam sras rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma'i rnam gzhag bu tshar sogs mkhas grub kha shas kyi gsung las btus shing ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub dang / ngag dbang chos grags la gtso bor brten pa zhal zas rab gsal/ 309 sa skya dkor dpon par nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'gro don bzang po/ 310 mgon dkar dmag zor bsangs mchod/ 311 me stag zla 9 tshes 1 la khams ab la sku skyer 'jigs byed bris thang zhig bskur ba'i rgyab yig mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bgyis pa/ 312 rgyal dbang rin po cher zhabs brtan zhal bzhes/ 313 bsam yas rab byung grwa tshang par phur 'chams la skyon 'don gnang ba/ 314 a dkar thang sgar thog sbyar ba'i khrus gsol/ 315 tse'u dmar sku phebs skabs phul ba/ 316 bye tshogs chos skyong la phul ba/ 317 lha khang mkhan po chos bkra shis gsar bkod skabs sgo rum snyan dar zhal byang / 318 shi gson gyi gdags yig 319 rtse gdong gi g.yag rwa lnga'i rten bshad dge 320 rdo rje phur pa'i rig 'dzin bskul gyi zhal skong a mes zhabs yab sras dbon sogs kyi rnam thar nyung ngu / 321 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la klu chen brgyad bskor gyi char 'bebs dngos grub sprin phung / 322 thugs sgrub sad bsrung le tshan gyi:
